title: The Episode About Baba Banda And Bahadur Shah S

blocks.text: Even after the scouts report back, Bahadur Shah still prefers diplomacy and drafts a conciliatory letter rather than risking open disaster in battle.
He praises Banda for killing hated officials, speaks as though there were common ground between them, and uses the language of settlement instead of immediate war.
The page centers on the emperor’s conciliatory letter as an instrument of delay, caution, and attempted soft handling.
